title: Laplace Transform Equation Solving Walkthrough
full_prompt: Write a Manim scene that visualizes the strategy of solving a differential equation using the Laplace Transform. First, create a 2x2 layout representing the four stages of the process: Top-Left (Differential Equation), Bottom-Left (Transformed Equation), Bottom-Right (Transformed Solution), and Top-Right (Solution). Draw arrows connecting these stages: a downward arrow for the Laplace Transform, a rightward arrow for algebraic solving, and an upward arrow for the Inverse Laplace Transform. Label these arrows appropriately. Color the bottom row (s-domain) yellow and the top row (time-domain) blue/white. Highlight the domains by splitting the screen into a 'Time domain' (top half) and an 's domain' (bottom half) using background rectangles. Then, transition to showing a concrete differential equation $m x''(t) + \mu x'(t) + k x(t) = F_0 \cos(\omega t)$ and demonstrate its Laplace transform term-by-term.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing custom helper methods like get_lt_arrow or grow_lt_arrow when inheriting classes
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure all helper methods from PreviewStrategy are correctly defined or inherited in the final scene.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using FullScreenRectangle in standard Manim Community without defining it
common_failure_modes.note: FullScreenRectangle is a ManimGL-specific class. In Manim Community, use a standard Rectangle with screen dimensions.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect string matching keys in TransformMatchingStrings
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure the key_map dictionary matches actual substrings present in the source and target text.
